title: Zuma Marble Blast
description: Rotate an ancient stone launcher in the heart of jungle ruins—shoot colorful marbles into rolling chains to spark explosive match-3 combos before they reach the skull.
controls: Aim with pointer or touch and click/tap to fire colorful marbles into the rolling track to match three or more.

zh-CN.title: 经典祖玛
zh-CN.description: 国民回忆杀神作经典祖玛：旋转神庙石像发射彩色弹珠，精准打入滚珠长龙触发连锁三消爆破，在进洞前全清通关！
zh-CN.controls: 移动准星并点击屏幕发射彩色祖玛珠，凑齐三个及以上同色相连即可消除并触发连击。
